escalation_to_external.trigger_conditions: If one of the parties does not agree with the decision.

case_handling.process_notes: The committee investigates complaints under the complaints regulation and the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity.

prevention_and_training.notes: PhD candidates are offered courses at university and faculty level; new academic staff sign the Code of Conduct on Academic Integrity.

open_questions: Is there a dedicated research integrity coordination office beyond the committee and confidential counsellor? If so, where is it positioned?
data_status.notes: Sources document the committee, confidential counsellor, and reporting line; office placement beyond these structures is not explicit.

extracted_text_snippets.snippet: The Academic Integrity Committee investigates suspected violations of academic integrity by employees of Leiden University.
The committee formulates its advice on the merits of the complaint and submits it to the Executive Board.
If one of the parties does not agree, the decision can be submitted for a second opinion to the Netherlands Board on Research Integrity (LOWI).
Confidential Counsellor is your initial point of contact for questions or circumstances related to academic integrity.

With effect from 1 January 2018 the Leiden University Committee for Academic Integrity and the Committee for Academic Integrity at the Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) have been merged into a single committee.
PhD candidates are offered courses at both university and faculty level. All new members of the academic staff sign the Code of Conduct on Academic Integrity.
The confidential counsellor for research integrity is your first port of call for any questions or situations relating to research integrity.
